summary: The audit checks ENGR 50 (or 50E or 50M) and six MATSCI courses from the list or other undergraduate MATSCI courses numbered 100 and above, each letter graded when a letter grade is offered, with a C or better. Checked by hand: the 2.0 GPA, the 3-unit minimum for unlisted MATSCI courses, and petitions to count graduate courses not on the list (you move those in). No transfer or test credit counts toward this minor.

lsT5iApL.why: "*Any MatSci course 100+ taken for a minimum of 3 units can count towards six class requirement". The 3-unit minimum is not set on the rule: it would also reject the listed MATSCI 126, a 2-unit course. Policies: "Students can petition to count graduate-level courses toward their minor." So the open pool leaves out graduate courses (the listed MATSCI 201 and 303 still count); a petitioned one is moved in by hand.

program.why: Grading: "All courses for the minor requirements must be taken for a letter grade if offered by the instructor." "The minimum grade in each course is a C."

node.name: Cumulative GPA of 2.0 for minor courses
